component.name: Marcel
component.summary: Browse files with a fast, persistent preview pane

description.p: Marcel is a graphical file manager for Linux built around a preview pane that stays open and useful while you browse. It renders its own interface with GPUI, the framework behind the Zed editor, so it depends on neither GTK nor Qt and does not inherit a desktop toolkit's theming or startup cost.

ul.li: List and grid views, breadcrumbs, bookmarks, and the usual XDG places in a sidebar
Sort by name, modified time, size, or kind, with folders first
Type a path directly, or start typing to filter the current folder with fuzzy matching
Folders update as they change on disk rather than reloading
Text and code files, images, continuously scrolling PDFs, and folder listings
Audio plays in the pane, with cover art, tags, a seekable waveform, and spectrum bars
Video shows a poster frame, its duration and codecs, and a button that hands it to your player
Thumbnails come from the freedesktop cache, shared with other applications
Copy and move with progress and cancellation
Replace, rename, skip, or merge when a destination is taken, answered once for the rest of the operation
Undo and redo across copy, move, duplicate, rename, Trash, restore, archive creation, extraction, and permission changes
Move To, through a small folder dialog
Properties with editable permission bits, ownership, timestamps, and what the preview loaders know about the file
Permanent deletion behind a confirmation, deliberately outside undo history
Zip archive creation and extraction of most common formats
A file manager over D-Bus, so "show in folder" from other applications opens Marcel
An xdg-desktop-portal FileChooser backend, so the open and save dialogs of other applications can be Marcel windows
File drag and drop with other applications on Wayland

description.p: Marcel checks that files are still what and where it thinks they are before touching them, and refuses rather than guessing.

screenshot.caption: Grid view with a PDF open in the preview pane

description.p: First release. Browsing with sorting and filtering, bookmarks, incremental directory watching, a preview pane for text, images, PDFs, audio, and video posters, undoable copy, move, duplicate, rename, Move To, Trash and restore, archive creation and extraction, a Properties dialog with editable permissions, D-Bus file-manager registration, an xdg-desktop-portal FileChooser backend, and bilateral Wayland file drag and drop.
